high_level_description: The image depicts a woman standing on a balcony with a scenic view of a landscape that includes a body of water, greenery, and distant hills. The woman is dressed in a white lace outfit consisting of a short-sleeved top and wide-leg pants. She is wearing flat sandals and has her hair styled in loose waves. Her posture is relaxed, with one hand resting on the railing of the balcony. The balcony itself features ornate black wrought-iron railings, adding an elegant touch to the setting.
